[Weekly table, Jan 4–8, Unit 3: Electricity and Magnetism, I Can] I can investigate electricity by asking questions, conducting investigations, analyzing evidence, and communicating what I learn about how electricity flows and powers everyday devices.
[Weekly table, Jan 4–8, Unit 3: Electricity and Magnetism, I Can] I can investigate magnetism and explain how magnets work and how electricity and magnetism are connected.

[Weekly table, Jan 4–8, Support / PEC] 5P2BC Circuits, Conductors, and Insulators Guidance Practice: Creating a Closed Circuit
